editorial_basis: Provisional city-news priorities, not a verified ranking of Iranian residents by city.
rules: News affecting residence, transport, services, safety, employment and the Iranian community can override city ranking.
Emergencies and material nationwide regulatory changes always take precedence.
Filter off-topic stories, preserve sources, verify timestamps and avoid duplicates.
Migration content ranks ahead of geographic priority; city order is a tie-breaker.
A news report never establishes a legal change on its own. Cross-check against Göç İdaresi, Resmî Gazete or competent authority.
Distinguish migration to Turkey, internal migration, refugee/asylum reports, and regulations for Iranian citizens.
Avoid automatic copying of full text/photo/video where re-use rights have not been confirmed.
Official changes to migration law and Iran–Turkey flight disruptions override all city rankings.
Weather in multiple Turkish cities is a separate regular beat; severe weather nationwide takes priority.
All reports derived from @iran_flights_watcher must attribute source, show data timestamp, and carry the explicit purchase-decision disclaimer.
Ordinary municipal news is curated, at most two posts per day for the entire Turkey channel; urgent safety or travel disruptions bypass this quota.
Do not publish ceremonial publicity or routine municipal press releases without practical audience value.

flight_policy.scope: all airports and cities in Iran and Turkey regardless of city ranking

weather_policy.source: Open-Meteo for forecast; MGM for official warnings
weather_policy.model_air_source: Open-Meteo / CAMS model, not official station measurement
weather_policy.details: Daily temperatures and precipitation, current temperature and model-based AQI (Open-Meteo/CAMS, explicitly not station measurement). Missing or stale data omitted. One six-city digest per slot.

flight_watcher.name: Iran Flights Watcher
claimed_sources: Istanbul Airport official flight status boards
Tehran Imam Khomeini Airport official flight status boards
flight_watcher.verification: Check original airport boards where possible; treat watcher estimates as third-party historical data
flight_watcher.required_disclaimer_fa: این گزارش بر اساس سابقهٔ انجام یا لغو پروازها تهیه شده و تضمینی برای انجام پرواز آینده نیست. تصمیم خرید بلیت بر عهدهٔ خود مسافر است و تهیه‌کنندهٔ این آمار مسئولیتی دربارهٔ تصمیم خرید یا پیامدهای آن نمی‌پذیرد.
flight_watcher.presentation: Do not independently characterize any flight as lowest risk or guaranteed; attribution and observation time mandatory

fx_policy.reporting: publish only when a verified new rate exceeds a configured threshold; daily digest if changes not material

sources.IRR: Independent Iranian free-market toman source required; official IRR shall not be substituted

fx_policy.staleness: Label source day; do not call daily reference rates realtime; hide unavailable IRR instead of inventing price
fx_policy.conversion_note: 1 TRY in target units, with reciprocal USD/EUR/GBP and toman = rial/10 only when validated source is available
fx_policy.approved_stream: TCMB indicative TRY rates for USD EUR GBP, update only with source-new date and >=0.30% material movement
fx_policy.iran_rial_stream: pending separately verified Iranian free market provider; never infer from TCMB indicative IRR

savings_radar.objective: Verifiable net savings for residents of Turkiye, not raw ads
publish_if: seller-offer link or dated catalog is verified
offer is currently valid and has unambiguous product size and unit price
real net savings supported by valid comparative reference or historical price
cost and geographic applicability are stated; separate loyalty/app requirements
not duplicated and not a generic advertisement
savings_radar.posting_policy: Two curated digests daily; urgent short-lived high-value offers as needed; no automatic reposting of copyrighted catalog images without permission.
savings_radar.consumer_disclaimer: قیمت و موجودی ممکن است با شعبه و زمان تغییر کند؛ پیش از خرید، قیمت نهایی را در فروشگاه بررسی کنید.

cross_border_policy.require_iranian_retail_viability: Do not declare export/resale profitability without documented landed costs and rules
cross_border_policy.label: Turkey local price, not delivered price in Iran
cross_border_policy.no_unauthorized_commerce: Do not claim goods may be freely imported without checking relevant rules

in_scope: major citywide water and electricity outages
major local events relevant to Iranian residents
out_of_scope: minor local crime without material public impact
city_news_policy.publication_status: editorial-policy-set; city-news collector not yet verified
